title: backgroundoperation
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): createdby, createdonbehalfby, modifiedby, modifiedonbehalfby.

backgroundoperationstatuscode.description: The status reason for background operation.

createdon.description: Date and time when the record was created.

displayname.description: The is display name of background operation.

errorcode.description: The error code of error for background operation in case of failure.

errormessage.description: The error message of error for background operation in case of failure.

importsequencenumber.description: Sequence number of the import that created this record.

inputparameters.description: The input parameters that were supplied to start background operation.

modifiedon.description: Date and time when the record was modified.

name.description: The name of the background operation.

overriddencreatedon.description: Date and time that the record was migrated.

priority.description: The priority of background operation execution.

retrycount.description: The number of times background operation was retried.

starttime.description: The date time when background operation started execution.
